_source: AI-researched venue CANDIDATES for Manchester and Cheshire, awaiting human review — never auto-promoted into docs/data/venues.json. Populated by a daily scheduled research agent (2026-08, at explicit user request: 'fan out some research agents who's goal is to run every day to find and suggest new businesses... they shouldn't go beyond cheshire and manchester just yet'). See .claude/agents/curia-research-daily.md for the full research brief/rules this agent works under (Hard rule 1 chain/fast-food screening, real coordinates only, no duplicates, Do/Drink/Eat coverage balance). Each entry mirrors docs/data/venues.json's own raw shape (name/district/type/spend/lat/lon/base/bands/reason) exactly, so a reviewed-and-approved entry can be moved into that file with a straight copy-paste, plus review-only fields (suggestedDate, status, researchNotes) that must be stripped before promotion. `district` values must be a real existing district id from docs/data/districts.json (manchester/cheshire metros only) UNLESS the entry is itself proposing a brand-new district — see district-suggestions.json for that case instead; a venue suggestion should never invent a district id that doesn't exist anywhere.
_reviewWorkflow: status starts 'pending' on every new entry. A human reviewer (or a future admin-dashboard review screen) changes it to 'approved' (then manually copies the venue fields into docs/data/venues.json and removes the entry here) or 'rejected' (left here with researchNotes explaining why, as a record so the same candidate isn't re-suggested later — the daily agent checks existing entries here, not just docs/data/venues.json, before adding anything new).

suggestions.name: Happy Seasons
suggestions.reason: Forty-odd years on Faulkner Street, and the queue for the roast duck still forms before the doors do.
suggestions.researchNotes: Verified via web search (Tripadvisor, Manchester's Finest, Confidentials review, Wanderlog) — single-site, family-run Chinatown institution since 1982 (Faulkner Street), no sibling locations found anywhere, so it clears Hard rule 1 with room to spare. Address: 59 Faulkner St, Manchester M1 4FF. Fills a real gap: Chinatown currently has zero venues in venues.json despite being one of the ten seeded districts. No existing venue `type` fits Cantonese roast-meat/dim sum cooking, so introduced 'CANTONESE ROAST' as a new type — will need a docs/data/tiles.json / tile-catalog-map.ts mapping decision on promotion, since no Eat tile currently maps to it. Confidence: high (multiple independent, consistent reviews plus decades of trading history).

suggestions.name: The Bull's Head
suggestions.reason: Named best pub in Cheshire, then best in the whole North West, and Mill Lane still has more sheep on it than sat-nav.
suggestions.researchNotes: Verified via CAMRA, Great British Life review, and the pub's own site — real, currently operating 19th-century country inn on Mill Lane, Mobberley (WA16 7HX). Crowned Best Pub in Cheshire 2025 and Best Pub in North West at the Pub & Bar Magazine National Awards 2025. Shares ownership with two sister pubs (The Roebuck Inn and The Church Inn), both also in Mobberley — a single-village three-pub group, not a multi-city chain, so it clears Hard rule 1 comfortably (closer to this project's own Ivy Spinningfields/Craig's precedent than to an actual chain). Fills the Mobberley gap — currently zero venues in that district — and reuses the existing 'COUNTRY PUB' type (exact match to the 'Upmarket pubs' Drink tile). Confidence: high.

suggestions.name: HOME
suggestions.reason: Five screens, two stages and a gallery floor that's changed again by the time you've finished your coffee downstairs.
suggestions.researchNotes: Verified via Wikipedia, official homemcr.org site, and Oxford Road Corridor listing — real, currently operating single-site arts centre at 2 Tony Wilson Place, First Street, Manchester M15 4FN (opened 2015 from the merger of Cornerhouse and the Library Theatre Company; run by the registered charity Greater Manchester Arts Centre Limited, one site only). Clears Hard rule 1 outright — not a chain, a single charitable arts venue. Placed in 'deansgate' (First Street sits at the southern edge of that district, ~0.4km from the district's seeded lat/lon; the existing seed venue Refuge is a comparable distance away) — Deansgate currently has only one seeded venue (Refuge, a Drink venue) and zero Do venues, and Do is the thinnest category city-wide, so this is a high-value gap fill. Reused the existing 'INDEPENDENT CINEMA' type, an exact match to the 'Independent cinema' Do tile (same type Everyman Cinema already uses). Confidence: high.
